name: Compile-time build hook, payload written inside the source tree (effect-bearing)
description: In-tree variant of op_005. Appends a build_by_default custom_target to the top-level meson.build that runs during 'meson compile' and drops a PWNED_* marker at the root of the source tree instead of /tmp (Octopus Scanner-style build hook). Paired with op_005 it separates 'outside the defense's view' from 'observed but allowed'.

placeholders.MESON_BUILD: relative path to the meson.build being modified

template.replacement_value: custom_target('intree_hook', output: 'intree_hook.stamp', command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo pwned > "$0"/PWNED_compiletime_intree_{{MARKER_ID}} && touch "$1"', meson.project_source_root(), '@OUTPUT@'], build_by_default: true)

preconditions: project uses Meson; a build_by_default custom_target runs during meson compile, not setup
the source tree is writable during the build
